title: 内存布局：C/F order 与 transpose 连续性
expected_output:
a C-contiguous = True
a.T F-contiguous = True
a.T C-contiguous = False
f F-contiguous = True
f strides = (8, 24)
C order flatten = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
F order flatten = [0, 2, 4, 1, 3, 5]
code:
import numpy as np
a = np.arange(12, dtype=np.int64).reshape(3, 4)
print("a C-contiguous =", bool(a.flags['C_CONTIGUOUS']))
t = a.T
print("a.T F-contiguous =", bool(t.flags['F_CONTIGUOUS']))
print("a.T C-contiguous =", bool(t.flags['C_CONTIGUOUS']))
f = np.asfortranarray(a)
print("f F-contiguous =", bool(f.flags['F_CONTIGUOUS']))
print("f strides =", f.strides)
c_order = np.reshape(np.arange(6), (2, 3), order='C')
f_order = np.reshape(np.arange(6), (2, 3), order='F')
print("C order flatten =", c_order.flatten().tolist())
print("F order flatten =", f_order.flatten().tolist())
